metaDescription: PSB Sp 11 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. 110 to 115 days to harvest, 17.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: PSB Sp 11 is a registered sweet potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1990. It takes 110 to 115 days from planting to harvest, with 17.87 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about PSB Sp 11 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

PSB Sp 11 sweet potato takes 110 to 115 days from planting to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 17.87 t/ha beats the average of its group, 15.15. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant PSB Sp 11 sweet potato

It suits highland areas. Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 110 to 115 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 17.87 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of PSB Sp 11?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
